hanzo.Target Practice: Free scaling for tagging all 5 once, do it early and your poke range balloons for the rest of the game.
hanzo.Explosive Arrows: Turns Storm Bow into instant waveclear so you can shove and roam, take it on maps that reward soak.
hanzo.Never Outmatched: Autos refund Scatter's cooldown, keeping your bounce-shot pick tool up far more often in skirmish-heavy games.
hanzo.Dragonstrike: Your teamfight zoning ult, drop it on the objective or a clumped enemy to force them off with huge sustained AoE.
hanzo.Fleet of Foot: Stacks move speed off Storm Bow hits, take it to kite dive and hold spacing while you keep poking.
hanzo.Piercing Arrows: The damage spike: Storm Bow and Scatter pierce, doubling waveclear and letting one arrow tag a whole line.
hanzo.Perfect Agility: A second reposition charge, take it when they can dive you so you always keep an out after committing.

hogger.On The Prowl: Rage on demand plus rage-scaled healing, your lane sustain and the fuel to keep abilities firing in a brawl.
hogger.Brute Force: Auto-attack quest that permanently ups your damage, plus more Loot Hoard reach for wall-slam setups.
hogger.Dense Blasting Powder: Loads extra dynamite into your combo, the burst spike that turns a wall-stun into a kill.
hogger.Hoardapult: Your ranged engage, ride the hoard onto their backline with a slow attached to lock a target down.
hogger.Dust Devil: Armor through your Hogg Wild spin, take it vs burst so you survive diving into their line.
hogger.Headbanger: Payoff for the wall-slam: longer stun and bonus max-health damage make your signature combo lethal.
hogger.Secret Stash: Turns Hoardapult into a dynamite machine gun, huge zone pressure and follow-up after the engage.

illidan.Immolation: Lifesteal-fueled burn gives the lane sustain and waveclear to keep diving without a healer babysitting you.
illidan.Reflexive Block: Physical armor on Dive, take vs auto-attack comps so you survive the moment you land on their backline.
illidan.Rapid Chase: Move speed and a cd refund on Dive into heroes, your reset to chain-dive and stick to a fleeing target.
illidan.The Hunt: Your global engage and stun, flank from across the map to lock their carry and start the fight on your terms.
illidan.Nimble Defender: Armor each time Sweeping Strike tags a hero, the in-fight survivability so you bruise instead of getting bursted.
illidan.Blades of Azzinoth: The damage spike: hit 5 heroes with sweep and your autos hit like a truck, wins extended brawls.
illidan.Demonic Form: Permanent meta for attack speed and 50% CC reduction, the late answer to being kited and locked down.

imperius.Impaling Light: Rewards stacking Valorous Brand before you stun, more marks means a longer Charge stun and a lower cooldown.
imperius.Press Forward: Globe armor and refreshed regen when you trade, the sustain that wins his solo lane against other bruisers.
imperius.Flash of Anger: Turns your marks into burst plus a shield, the spike that lets a Charge combo actually delete a squishy.
imperius.Angelic Armaments: A big on-demand shield that fires back damage, the safer ult when you need to survive the dive you start.
imperius.Divine Rage: Every mark you consume refreshes Molten Armor, keeping your sustain and waveclear engine running in fights.
imperius.Celestial Swiftness: Move and attack speed after every Charge, take it to stick to targets and cash the stun in with autos.
imperius.Unrelenting Descent: Refills a big chunk of health and mana when you dive in, the reset that lets you commit fight after fight.

jaina.Winter's Reach: More Frostbolt reach and speed so you land the Chill from safer range, the setup for every combo you throw.
jaina.Frost Shards: Frostbolt pierces two, so you clear waves and Chill a whole clump at once for follow-up Blizzard damage.
jaina.Ice Lance: Frostbolt on a Chilled target refunds cd and mana, the engine that lets you machine-gun spells at frozen enemies.
jaina.Ring of Frost: Your zoning ult and combo finisher, root a clump then dump Blizzard on top, take it when they group.
jaina.Storm Front: Bigger, longer-range Blizzard, cast it from safety and blanket more of the fight to keep everyone Chilled.
jaina.Snowstorm: The burst spike, later Blizzard waves hit far harder, turning your zone into real kill pressure on a clump.
jaina.Cold Snap: Ring freezes twice, extending your lockdown and letting a single ult set up a full wombo.

johanna.Divine Fortress: Stacks physical armor off your autos plus bonus health, the backbone of her near-unkillable frontline.
johanna.Subdue: Non-decaying 80% slow when you clip two heroes, locks a target in place for your team to collapse.
johanna.Sins Exposed: Punish shuts off enemy healing, take it into heavy-sustain comps where your kills otherwise slip away.
johanna.Falling Sword: Global engage that makes allies under you unstoppable, your initiation or a save from across the map.
johanna.Roar: Big Punish damage when it clips multiple targets, adding real teamfight burst on top of the slow.
johanna.Shrinking Vacuum: Condemn now weakens and slows, a peel tool that blunts their dive and buys a diving ally an out.
johanna.Indestructible: A full-health shield the instant you'd die, the reason she anchors a fight no one can break through.

junkrat.Extra-Wound Timers: Beefs up your last grenade and keeps nades live longer, more zone and burst out of one Frag reload.
junkrat.Taste For Explosions: The damage quest, stack it early by tagging heroes with Frags so your whole kit scales into midgame.
junkrat.Bogged Down: Concussion Mine slows on landing, so the enemy you boop stays put for your Frags and your team's follow-up.
junkrat.RIP-Tire: Your pick and zone ult, drive it around a corner to blow up a squishy or force them off an objective.
junkrat.Bombs Away: Auto then Frag deals bonus damage at extra range, smoothing your in-lane trades and poke DPS.
junkrat.Endless Nades: Hero hits refund Frag's cooldown, the sustained-damage spike that lets you never stop lobbing in a fight.
junkrat.Cannonball!: Bigger grenade and splash radius, take it for consistency so you stop clipping the small hitboxes you chase.

kaelthas.Fel Infusion: A flat spell-power bump and a heal each rotation, free scaling and the sustain to keep poking without a healer.
kaelthas.Nether Wind: Longer Gravity Lapse with a mana refund, your setup lift, land it and the whole combo lands for free.
kaelthas.Burned Flesh: Flamestrike adds max-health damage when it catches two, the reason it hits like a truck into grouped fights.
kaelthas.Phoenix: Sustained AoE that zones and chunks a clump for 7 seconds, the ult that beats Pyroblast when they fight together.
kaelthas.Fission Bomb: Wider Living Bomb spread, so your bombs chain across a stack and multiply the AoE off one cast.
kaelthas.Fury of the Sunwell: Flamestrike detonates twice, doubling your burst, the spike that turns a rooted target into a corpse.
kaelthas.Rebirth: Phoenix lasts twice as long and you steer it, turning your ult into a persistent zone that reshapes the fight.

kelthuzad.Barbed Chains: Loads damage and armor shred onto Chains, the pull that starts every combo now hits and softens the target.
kelthuzad.Strip Shields: Permanent stacking shield each time you land Chains, the survivability that keeps your squishy mage comboing.
kelthuzad.Accelerated Decay: Death and Decay ramps the longer they sit in it, the core of his damage, punishing anyone rooted in your zone.
kelthuzad.Frost Blast: Your delete button, a rooted-target nuke that with a clean Chains-Nova setup one-shots their carry.
kelthuzad.Icy Grasp: Beefier Frost Nova slow that refunds its own cd on damage, the CC engine that locks targets for the combo.
kelthuzad.Arcane Echoes: D&D explosions cut their own cooldown, keeping your damage zone up nearly constantly in a drawn-out fight.
kelthuzad.The Damned Return: A shade doubles your Death and Decay, stacking two damage pools for absurd teamfight and zone output.

kerrigan.Siphoning Impact: Ravage grants shields on hit, the survivability that lets her dive in, combo, and come back out alive.
kerrigan.Sharpened Blades: Ravage's damage quest, farm the early stacks so your engage combo actually kills instead of just poking.
kerrigan.Queen of Blades: Cuts Ravage's cooldown and doubles PvE damage, better waveclear and a faster reset to reach the backline.
kerrigan.Maelstrom: AoE nuke that caps her pull combo, drop it after Impaling Blades to melt everyone you lassoed together.
kerrigan.Volatile Power: More shields per damage dealt, take it to be the tankier all-in threat when you're the one starting fights.
kerrigan.Painful Spikes: Impaled targets take bonus damage from your next hits, the spike that guarantees the pull becomes a kill.
kerrigan.Omegastorm: Maelstrom extends each time it damages a hero, turning a clumped fight into a long self-sustaining AoE grind.

kharazim.Transcendence: Turns your autos into healing, the build that lets you punch the fight and top the diving ally at once.
kharazim.Earth Ally: A physical-armor totem, take it into auto-attack comps to blunt their carry while your team stands on it.
kharazim.Heavenly Zeal: Dashing to an ally supercharges their Breath of Heaven heal and speeds you both, your dive-follow tool.
kharazim.Divine Palm: Cheat-death on an ally, the clutch save that eats their whole burst combo and hands you the fight.
kharazim.Quicksilver: Dash grants both of you move speed, take it to chase kills or kite a dive off your carry.
kharazim.Cleansing Touch: Dash makes an ally unstoppable, a mini-cleanse that pulls a target out of a stun chain or Ring of Frost.
kharazim.Peaceful Repose: If they survive, Palm's cooldown drops to 5 seconds, so you can throw the big save nearly every fight.

leoric.Ossein Renewal: A big self-heal on demand refreshed by globes, the sustain that lets him out-brawl anyone who pokes him.
leoric.Paralyzing Rage: A stronger Skeletal Swing slow, take it to stick to a target or peel a dive off your backline.
leoric.Willing Vessel: Drain Hope heals a huge chunk of his health, the tether becomes a full lifeline in extended fights.
leoric.Entomb: A wall ult that splits their team or traps a target, your setup for a kill or a clutch peel.
leoric.Unyielding Despair: Drain Hope's cooldown melts while it's active, keeping the tether and its damage and heal up almost always.
leoric.Crushing Hope: Full-duration Drain Hope rips max-health damage, the payoff that makes him a genuine tank-shredder.
leoric.Death March: The final ult swing tethers everyone nearby with Drain Hope, chaining lockdown and damage across their team.

lili.Eager Adventurer: Longer Fast Feet and mana regen, more uptime on the speed that keeps her alive and her mana healthy.
lili.Wind Serpent: Cloud Serpent speeds up and hits harder, boosting both your passive healing throughput and your poke.
lili.The Good Stuff: Adds a heal-over-time to Brew, doubled while Fast Feet is up, a real healing spike for a random-target healer.
lili.Jug of 1,000 Cups: A massive channeled team heal, take it as your emergency button to out-heal a sustained teamfight.
lili.Hindering Winds: A stronger, longer Blinding Wind slow, turning your anti-auto blind into a kiting and peel tool too.
lili.Pick Me Up: Brew heals far more on low allies, so her randomness still lands big when a teammate is about to die.
lili.Double Dragon: A second Water Dragon on impact, doubling the blind and damage, your best teamfight-tempo pick.

liming.Force Armor: Spell armor whenever your missiles connect, the buffer that keeps a zero-defense mage alive through burst.
liming.Triumvirate: Arcane Orb refunds cd and mana on a hero hit, your sustainable poke and waveclear from max range.
liming.Seeker: Third Magic Missile on one target adds big burst, rewarding you for locking your poke onto a single squishy.
liming.Wave of Force: A knockback that self-peels and disengages, take it over Disintegrate when their dive would otherwise delete you.
liming.Illusionist: A kill already resets Teleport; this resets it when you take burst too, your extra get-out-of-jail button.
liming.Diamond Skin: Teleport hands you a shield, stacking with the reset so every blink is also a survival cooldown.
liming.Repulsion: Massively longer Wave of Force range and knockback, turning your peel into a fight-wide displacement tool.

lostvikings.Olaf the Stout: Beefs up your durable Viking with health and periodic armor, so Olaf can hold a lane and eat a gank attempt.
lostvikings.Erik the Swift: Erik moves faster and self-heals on the go, the mobility that makes triple-lane soak and escapes reliable.
lostvikings.Norse Force!: An on-demand shield across all three, your panic button to survive a collapse and keep your soakers alive.
lostvikings.Longboat Raid!: Bundles the Vikings into a fighting boat, the ult that lets them contest teamfights and push, not just soak.
lostvikings.Jump!: Invulnerability and pass-through for all Vikings, the ungankable escape when they finally catch a lone body.
lostvikings.64 KB Marathon: Go Go Go bursts speed and breaks roots, your rotation and disengage tool to keep all three lanes covered.
lostvikings.The Sequel!: Halves the death timer, so a caught Viking is back soaking almost immediately, minimizing the lost XP.
